WITH execution_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    o.orderbase,
    AVG(oe.fillcount) AS avg_fillcount,
    COUNT(oe.orderexecmark) AS exec_count
  FROM orders o
  INNER JOIN orderexecutions oe ON o.recordvault = oe.ordersmark
  GROUP BY o.orderbase
)
SELECT 
  orderbase,
  avg_fillcount,
  exec_count,
  exec_count * 1.0 / SUM(exec_count) OVER () AS fraction
FROM execution_stats
ORDER BY orderbase
